meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会把你在 NanoClaw 项目里做的所有个性化修改（配置、代码、角色等）整理成一份迁移指南；升级到上游新版时，先取干净的新版代码，再按指南把你的修改重新做一遍，从而避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw 的 fork 升级到上游版本并保留自己的改动时；如果已存在迁移指南，它也会询问是否直接跳到升级。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游，保留我的所有自定义修改。
say.note: 它会先做预检查，再提取你的修改并生成指南。

say.text: 先分析一下我和上游的差异，列个改动清单。
say.note: 它会用子代理探索代码库，评估改动范围。

say.text: 我已经有迁移指南了，直接开始升级吧。
say.note: 它会跳过提取，直接进入升级阶段。

howto.what_en: This skill extracts all your personal customizations (config, code, personas, etc.) from a NanoClaw fork into a migration guide. On upgrade, it checks out clean upstream code and reapplies your customizations from the guide, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade a NanoClaw fork to upstream while keeping your customizations. If a guide already exists, it offers to skip straight to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Upgrade this NanoClaw fork to upstream, keeping all my customizations.
say_en.note: It runs preflight, then extracts changes and builds the guide.

say_en.text: Analyze the differences between my fork and upstream, list the changes.
say_en.note: It spawns sub-agents to explore the codebase and assess scope.

say_en.text: I already have a migration guide—start the upgrade directly.
say_en.note: It skips extraction and goes to the upgrade phase.
